segments.recognized: THEN THE LORD SAID TO MOSES
segments.text: Then the LORD said to Moses,
segments.normalized: THEN THE LORD SAID TO MOSES

segments.recognized: S SPEAK TO THE WHOLE CONGREGATION OF ISRAEL AND TELL THEM BE HOLY BECAUSE I THE LORD YOUR GOD AM HOLY
segments.text: “Speak to the whole congregation of Israel and tell them: Be holy because I, the LORD your God, am holy.
segments.normalized: SPEAK TO THE WHOLE CONGREGATION OF ISRAEL AND TELL THEM BE HOLY BECAUSE I THE LORD YOUR GOD AM HOLY

segments.recognized: EACH OF YOU MUST RESPECT HIS MOTHER AND FATHER AND YOU MUST KEEP MY SABBATHS I AM THE LORD YOUR GOD
segments.text: Each of you must respect his mother and father, and you must keep My Sabbaths. I am the LORD your God.
segments.normalized: EACH OF YOU MUST RESPECT HIS MOTHER AND FATHER AND YOU MUST KEEP MY SABBATHS I AM THE LORD YOUR GOD

segments.recognized: DO NOT TURN TO IDOLS OR MAKE FOR YOURSELVES MOLTEN GODS I AM THE LORD YOUR GOD
segments.text: Do not turn to idols or make for yourselves molten gods. I am the LORD your God.
segments.normalized: DO NOT TURN TO IDOLS OR MAKE FOR YOURSELVES MOLTEN GODS I AM THE LORD YOUR GOD

segments.recognized: WHEN YOU SACRIFICE A PEACE OFFERING TO THE LORD YOU SHALL OFFER IT FOR YOUR ACCEPTANCE
segments.text: When you sacrifice a peace offering to the LORD, you shall offer it for your acceptance.
segments.normalized: WHEN YOU SACRIFICE A PEACE OFFERING TO THE LORD YOU SHALL OFFER IT FOR YOUR ACCEPTANCE

segments.recognized: IT SHALL BE EATEN ON THE DAY YOU SACRIFICE IT OR ON THE NEXT DAY BUT WHAT REMAINS ON THE THIRD DAY MUST BE BURNED UP
segments.text: It shall be eaten on the day you sacrifice it, or on the next day; but what remains on the third day must be burned up.
segments.normalized: IT SHALL BE EATEN ON THE DAY YOU SACRIFICE IT OR ON THE NEXT DAY BUT WHAT REMAINS ON THE THIRD DAY MUST BE BURNED UP

segments.recognized: IF ANY OF IT IS EATEN ON THE THIRD DAY IT IS TAINTED AND WILL NOT BE ACCEPTED
segments.text: If any of it is eaten on the third day, it is tainted and will not be accepted.
segments.normalized: IF ANY OF IT IS EATEN ON THE THIRD DAY IT IS TAINTED AND WILL NOT BE ACCEPTED

segments.recognized: WHOEVER EATS IT WILL BEAR HIS INIQUITY FOR HE HAS PROFANED WHAT IS WHOLY TO THE LORD THAT PERSON MUST BE CUT OFF FROM HIS PEOPLE
segments.text: Whoever eats it will bear his iniquity, for he has profaned what is holy to the LORD. That person must be cut off from his people.
segments.normalized: WHOEVER EATS IT WILL BEAR HIS INIQUITY FOR HE HAS PROFANED WHAT IS HOLY TO THE LORD THAT PERSON MUST BE CUT OFF FROM HIS PEOPLE

segments.recognized: WHEN YOU REAP THE HARVEST OF YOUR LAND YOU ARE NOT TO REAP TO THE VERY EDGES OF YOUR FIELD OR GATHER THE GLEANINGS OF YOUR HARVEST
segments.text: When you reap the harvest of your land, you are not to reap to the very edges of your field or gather the gleanings of your harvest.
segments.normalized: WHEN YOU REAP THE HARVEST OF YOUR LAND YOU ARE NOT TO REAP TO THE VERY EDGES OF YOUR FIELD OR GATHER THE GLEANINGS OF YOUR HARVEST

segments.recognized: YOU MUST NOT STRIP YOUR VINEYARD BARE OR GATHER ITS FALLEN GRAPES LEAVE THEM FOR THE POOR AND THE FOREIGNER I AM THE LORD YOUR GOD
segments.text: You must not strip your vineyard bare or gather its fallen grapes. Leave them for the poor and the foreigner. I am the LORD your God.
segments.normalized: YOU MUST NOT STRIP YOUR VINEYARD BARE OR GATHER ITS FALLEN GRAPES LEAVE THEM FOR THE POOR AND THE FOREIGNER I AM THE LORD YOUR GOD

segments.recognized: YOU MUST NOT STEAL YOU MUST NOT LIE OR DECEIVE ONE ANOTHER
segments.text: You must not steal. You must not lie or deceive one another.
segments.normalized: YOU MUST NOT STEAL YOU MUST NOT LIE OR DECEIVE ONE ANOTHER

segments.recognized: YOU MUST NOT SWEAR FALSELY BY MY NAME AND SO PROFANE THE NAME OF YOUR GOD I AM THE LORD
segments.text: You must not swear falsely by My name and so profane the name of your God. I am the LORD.
segments.normalized: YOU MUST NOT SWEAR FALSELY BY MY NAME AND SO PROFANE THE NAME OF YOUR GOD I AM THE LORD

segments.recognized: YOU MUST NOT DEFRAUD YOUR NEIGHBOUR OR ROB HIM YOU MUST NOT WITHHOLD UNTIL MORNING THE WAGES DO A HIRED HAND
segments.text:
You must not defraud your neighbor or rob him.
You must not withhold until morning the wages due a hired hand.
segments.normalized: YOU MUST NOT DEFRAUD YOUR NEIGHBOR OR ROB HIM YOU MUST NOT WITHHOLD UNTIL MORNING THE WAGES DUE A HIRED HAND

segments.recognized: YOU MUST NOT CURSE THE DEAF OR PLACE A STUMBLING BLOCK BEFORE THE BLIND BUT YOU SHALL FEAR YOUR GOD I AM THE LORD
segments.text: You must not curse the deaf or place a stumbling block before the blind, but you shall fear your God. I am the LORD.
segments.normalized: YOU MUST NOT CURSE THE DEAF OR PLACE A STUMBLING BLOCK BEFORE THE BLIND BUT YOU SHALL FEAR YOUR GOD I AM THE LORD

segments.recognized: YOU MUST NOT PERVERT JUSTICE YOU MUST NOT SHOW PARTIALITY TO THE POOR OR FAVORITISM TO THE RICH YOU ARE TO JUDGE YOUR NEIGHBOUR FAIRLY
segments.text: You must not pervert justice; you must not show partiality to the poor or favoritism to the rich; you are to judge your neighbor fairly.
segments.normalized: YOU MUST NOT PERVERT JUSTICE YOU MUST NOT SHOW PARTIALITY TO THE POOR OR FAVORITISM TO THE RICH YOU ARE TO JUDGE YOUR NEIGHBOR FAIRLY

segments.recognized: YOU MUST NOT GO ABOUT SPREADING SLANDER AMONG YOUR PEOPLE YOU MUST NOT ENDANGER THE LIFE OF YOUR NEIGHBOUR I AM THE LORD
segments.text:
You must not go about spreading slander among your people.
You must not endanger the life of your neighbor. I am the LORD.
segments.normalized: YOU MUST NOT GO ABOUT SPREADING SLANDER AMONG YOUR PEOPLE YOU MUST NOT ENDANGER THE LIFE OF YOUR NEIGHBOR I AM THE LORD

segments.recognized: YOU MUST NOT HARBOUR HATRED AGAINST YOUR BROTHER IN YOUR HEART DIRECTLY REBUKE YOUR NEIGHBOUR SO THAT YOU WILL NOT INCUR GUILT ON ACCOUNT OF HIM
segments.text: You must not harbor hatred against your brother in your heart. Directly rebuke your neighbor, so that you will not incur guilt on account of him.
segments.normalized: YOU MUST NOT HARBOR HATRED AGAINST YOUR BROTHER IN YOUR HEART DIRECTLY REBUKE YOUR NEIGHBOR SO THAT YOU WILL NOT INCUR GUILT ON ACCOUNT OF HIM

segments.recognized: DO NOT SEEK REVENGE OR BEAR A GRUDGE AGAINST ANY OF YOUR PEOPLE BUT LOVE YOUR NEIGHBOUR AS YOURSELF I AM THE LORD
segments.text: Do not seek revenge or bear a grudge against any of your people, but love your neighbor as yourself. I am the LORD.
segments.normalized: DO NOT SEEK REVENGE OR BEAR A GRUDGE AGAINST ANY OF YOUR PEOPLE BUT LOVE YOUR NEIGHBOR AS YOURSELF I AM THE LORD

segments.recognized: YOU ARE TO KEEP MY STATUTES YOU SHALL NOT CROSS BREED TWO DIFFERENT KINDS OF LIVE STOCK YOU SHALL NOT SOW YOUR FIELDS WITH TWO KINDS OF SEED AND YOU SHALL NOT WEAR CLOTHING MADE OF TWO KINDS OF MATERIAL
segments.text: You are to keep My statutes. You shall not crossbreed two different kinds of livestock; you shall not sow your fields with two kinds of seed; and you shall not wear clothing made of two kinds of material.
segments.normalized: YOU ARE TO KEEP MY STATUTES YOU SHALL NOT CROSSBREED TWO DIFFERENT KINDS OF LIVESTOCK YOU SHALL NOT SOW YOUR FIELDS WITH TWO KINDS OF SEED AND YOU SHALL NOT WEAR CLOTHING MADE OF TWO KINDS OF MATERIAL

segments.recognized: IF A MAN LIES CARNALLY WITH A SLAVE GIRL PROMISED TO ANOTHER MAN BUT WHO HAS NOT BEEN REDEEMED OR GIVEN HER FREEDOM THERE MUST BE DUE PUNISHMENT BUT THEY ARE NOT TO BE PUT TO DEATH BECAUSE SHE HAS NOT BEEN FREED
segments.text: If a man lies carnally with a slave girl promised to another man but who has not been redeemed or given her freedom, there must be due punishment. But they are not to be put to death, because she had not been freed.
segments.normalized: IF A MAN LIES CARNALLY WITH A SLAVE GIRL PROMISED TO ANOTHER MAN BUT WHO HAS NOT BEEN REDEEMED OR GIVEN HER FREEDOM THERE MUST BE DUE PUNISHMENT BUT THEY ARE NOT TO BE PUT TO DEATH BECAUSE SHE HAD NOT BEEN FREED

segments.recognized: THE MAN HOWEVER MUST BRING A RAM TO THE ENTRANCE TO THE TENT OF MEETING AS HIS GUILT OFFERING TO THE LORD
segments.text: The man, however, must bring a ram to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting as his guilt offering to the LORD.
segments.normalized: THE MAN HOWEVER MUST BRING A RAM TO THE ENTRANCE TO THE TENT OF MEETING AS HIS GUILT OFFERING TO THE LORD

segments.recognized: THE PRIEST SHALL MAKE ATONEMENT ON HIS BEHALF BEFORE THE LORD WITH THE RAM OF THE GUILT OFFERING FOR THE SIN HE HAS COMMITTED AND HE WILL BE FORGIVEN THE SIN HE HAS COMMITTED
segments.text: The priest shall make atonement on his behalf before the LORD with the ram of the guilt offering for the sin he has committed, and he will be forgiven the sin he has committed.
segments.normalized: THE PRIEST SHALL MAKE ATONEMENT ON HIS BEHALF BEFORE THE LORD WITH THE RAM OF THE GUILT OFFERING FOR THE SIN HE HAS COMMITTED AND HE WILL BE FORGIVEN THE SIN HE HAS COMMITTED

segments.recognized: WHEN YOU ENTER THE LAND AND PLANT ANY KIND OF TREE FOR FOOD YOU SHALL REGARD THE FRUIT AS FORBIDDEN FOR THREE YEARS IT WILL BE FORBIDDEN TO YOU AND MUST NOT BE EATEN
segments.text: When you enter the land and plant any kind of tree for food, you shall regard the fruit as forbidden. For three years it will be forbidden to you and must not be eaten.
segments.normalized: WHEN YOU ENTER THE LAND AND PLANT ANY KIND OF TREE FOR FOOD YOU SHALL REGARD THE FRUIT AS FORBIDDEN FOR THREE YEARS IT WILL BE FORBIDDEN TO YOU AND MUST NOT BE EATEN

segments.recognized: IN THE FOURTH YEAR ALL ITS FRUIT MUST BE CONSECRATED AS A PRAISE OFFERING TO THE LORD
segments.text: In the fourth year all its fruit must be consecrated as a praise offering to the LORD.
segments.normalized: IN THE FOURTH YEAR ALL ITS FRUIT MUST BE CONSECRATED AS A PRAISE OFFERING TO THE LORD

segments.recognized: BUT IN THE FIFTH YEAR YOU MAY EAT ITS FRUIT THUS YOUR HARVEST WILL BE INCREASED I AM THE LORD YOUR GOD
segments.text: But in the fifth year you may eat its fruit; thus your harvest will be increased. I am the LORD your God.
segments.normalized: BUT IN THE FIFTH YEAR YOU MAY EAT ITS FRUIT THUS YOUR HARVEST WILL BE INCREASED I AM THE LORD YOUR GOD

segments.recognized: YOU MUST NOT EAT ANYTHING WITH BLOOD STILL IN IT YOU MUST NOT PRACTISE DIVINATION OR SORCERY
segments.text:
You must not eat anything with blood still in it.
You must not practice divination or sorcery.
segments.normalized: YOU MUST NOT EAT ANYTHING WITH BLOOD STILL IN IT YOU MUST NOT PRACTICE DIVINATION OR SORCERY

segments.recognized: YOU MUST NOT CUT OFF THE HAIR AT THE SIDES OF YOUR HEAD OR CLIP OFF THE EDGES OF YOUR BEARD
segments.text: You must not cut off the hair at the sides of your head or clip off the edges of your beard.
segments.normalized: YOU MUST NOT CUT OFF THE HAIR AT THE SIDES OF YOUR HEAD OR CLIP OFF THE EDGES OF YOUR BEARD

segments.recognized: YOU MUST NOT MAKE ANY CUTS IN YOUR BODIES FOR THE DEAD OR PUT TATTOO MARKS ON YOURSELVES I AM THE LORD
segments.text: You must not make any cuts in your bodies for the dead or put tattoo marks on yourselves. I am the LORD.
segments.normalized: YOU MUST NOT MAKE ANY CUTS IN YOUR BODIES FOR THE DEAD OR PUT TATTOO MARKS ON YOURSELVES I AM THE LORD

segments.recognized: YOU MUST NOT DEFILE YOUR DAUGHTER BY MAKING HER A PROSTITUTE OR THE LAND WILL BE PROSTITUTED AND FILLED WITH DEPRAVITY
segments.text: You must not defile your daughter by making her a prostitute, or the land will be prostituted and filled with depravity.
segments.normalized: YOU MUST NOT DEFILE YOUR DAUGHTER BY MAKING HER A PROSTITUTE OR THE LAND WILL BE PROSTITUTED AND FILLED WITH DEPRAVITY

segments.recognized: YOU MUST KEEP MY SABBATHS AND HAVE REVERENCE FOR MY SANCTUARY I AM THE LORD
segments.text: You must keep My Sabbaths and have reverence for My sanctuary. I am the LORD.
segments.normalized: YOU MUST KEEP MY SABBATHS AND HAVE REVERENCE FOR MY SANCTUARY I AM THE LORD

segments.recognized: YOU MUST NOT TURN TO MEDIUMS OR SPIRITISTS DO NOT SEEK THEM OUT OR YOU WILL BE DEFILED BY THEM I AM THE LORD YOUR GOD
segments.text: You must not turn to mediums or spiritists; do not seek them out, or you will be defiled by them. I am the LORD your God.
segments.normalized: YOU MUST NOT TURN TO MEDIUMS OR SPIRITISTS DO NOT SEEK THEM OUT OR YOU WILL BE DEFILED BY THEM I AM THE LORD YOUR GOD

segments.recognized: YOU ARE TO RISE IN THE PRESENCE OF THE ELDERLY HONOUR THE AGED AND FEAR YOUR GOD I AM THE LORD
segments.text: You are to rise in the presence of the elderly, honor the aged, and fear your God. I am the LORD.
segments.normalized: YOU ARE TO RISE IN THE PRESENCE OF THE ELDERLY HONOR THE AGED AND FEAR YOUR GOD I AM THE LORD

segments.recognized: WHEN A FOREIGNER RESIDES WITH YOU IN YOUR LAND YOU MUST NOT OPPRESS HIM
segments.text: When a foreigner resides with you in your land, you must not oppress him.
segments.normalized: WHEN A FOREIGNER RESIDES WITH YOU IN YOUR LAND YOU MUST NOT OPPRESS HIM

segments.recognized: YOU MUST TREAT THE FOREIGNER LIVING AMONG YOU AS NATIVE BORN AND LOVE HIM AS YOURSELF FOR YOU WERE FOREIGNERS IN THE LAND OF EGYPT I AM THE LORD YOUR GOD
segments.text: You must treat the foreigner living among you as native-born and love him as yourself, for you were foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.
segments.normalized: YOU MUST TREAT THE FOREIGNER LIVING AMONG YOU AS NATIVE BORN AND LOVE HIM AS YOURSELF FOR YOU WERE FOREIGNERS IN THE LAND OF EGYPT I AM THE LORD YOUR GOD

segments.recognized: YOU MUST NOT USE DISHONEST MEASURES OF LENGTH WEIGHT OR VOLUME
segments.text: You must not use dishonest measures of length, weight, or volume.
segments.normalized: YOU MUST NOT USE DISHONEST MEASURES OF LENGTH WEIGHT OR VOLUME

segments.recognized: YOU SHALL MAINTAIN HONEST SCALES AND WEIGHTS AN HONEST EPHA AND AN HONEST HYN I AM THE LORD YOUR GOD WHO BROUGHT YOU OUT OF THE LAND OF EGYPT
segments.text: You shall maintain honest scales and weights, an honest ephah, and an honest hin. I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.
segments.normalized: YOU SHALL MAINTAIN HONEST SCALES AND WEIGHTS AN HONEST EPHAH AND AN HONEST HIN I AM THE LORD YOUR GOD WHO BROUGHT YOU OUT OF THE LAND OF EGYPT

segments.recognized: YOU MUST KEEP ALL MY STATUTES AND ALL MY ORDINANCES AND FOLLOW THEM I AM THE LORD
segments.text: You must keep all My statutes and all My ordinances and follow them. I am the LORD.”
segments.normalized: YOU MUST KEEP ALL MY STATUTES AND ALL MY ORDINANCES AND FOLLOW THEM I AM THE LORD
